data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 篝火旁的晚餐分餐
data.description: 旅途营地，她跪坐在篝火边把炖菜分进每个人的碗里，尾巴被火光照得暖融融；确认大家都拿到之后才给自己盛，动作自然得像呼吸。
data.action: 旅途营地，她跪坐在篝火边把炖菜分进每个人的碗里，尾巴被火光照得暖融融
data.promptProse: Raphtalia kneels in her blue apron by the steaming stew, her soft raccoon ears and striped tail catching the firelight. Across from her a short-haired traveler in an olive cloak reaches with both hands to steady an earthenware bowl while she ladles into it. Other waiting bowls sit beside the pot at the edge of the fire.
data.animaCaption: Raphtalia, with brown raccoon ears and a blue apron, leans over the pot and ladles into the bowl held by the short dark-haired traveler in an olive cloak across the fire.
